theorem: For balanced tuples with every freely reduced relator length<=2, triviality is equivalent to a forest with one singleton per component. Ungrounded components have an explicit C2 quotient. In the trivial case ordinary relator operations propagate singleton generators at fixed rank without exceeding length2.
scope: No shortness alone is called a solve. Exactly length2 in every nonempty row gives the all-generators-to-C2 obstruction.
